title: Error message developed under older Android version
body:
I created the APK both via Web build as well as via Android Studio. I got an error message that it was programmed under an old Android version. I installed it nevertheless. Now it is not possible to import any exported data, which means that I have to go through the entire objectives again. My calculated HBA1C has already increased by more than 1 unit, which is really bad. Any suggestions for me to overcome this?

I tried for both a Xiaomi mobile phone with the latest OS as well as a Samsung S25.
